hops.rationale: The GS 2026-filing passages (accession 000088698226000091, Item 8) directly state the requested regulatory capital ratio disclosures. Passage 180 gives the Standardized CET1 ratio (15.0% vs 15.3%), Tier 1 (16.8% vs 17.1%) and Total capital ratio (18.8% vs 18.6%) as of December 2025 and 2024, plus the Tier 1 leverage ratio (6.6% vs 6.8%) and SLR (5.2% vs 5.5%). Passage 178 supplies the minimum requirements framework, and passage 181 (adjacent to 180) defines the leverage ratio terms and covers GS Bank USA's capital framework. Passage 182 adds the GS Bank USA well-capitalized thresholds. Together these cover the CET1, Tier 1, total capital, Tier 1 leverage and SLR elements. The disclosures are the December 2025 figures with December 2024 comparatives, as reported in this 2026-filed 10-K. No passage is irrelevant and no further retrieval is needed for the original goal.
